answer: To resist Sybil attacks, each AI agent must computationally derive a unique cryptographic proof, analogous to mining rare quartz. This process is time-consuming, requiring significant computational resources per identity. The resulting proof, like a blooming lotus, signifies a genuine, non-replicated entity. Attacks are deterred by the prohibitive cost of generating proofs for myriad fake identities, ensuring a robust network where genuine contributions, like medicinal yarrow, thrive.
